Go to my operation and he'll set you up with everything you need.|Lando Calrissian|}} '''W1-LE''', commonly known as "'''Willie'''," was an [[RQ protocol droid]] owned by [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] since the [[Clone Wars]]. Willie originally had a different body type, however sometime before the [[Siege of Lothal]] Calrissian transferred Willie's logic unit into an RQ protocol droid. Willie helped Lando to manage his [[Lando Calrissian's farm|farm]] and illegal [[mining]] operation on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Lothal]]. After the [[Spectres]] made a deal with Calrissian for safe passage from the planet, the droid completed the transaction in Lando's absence. ==Biography== W1-LE was the "galactic entrepreneur" [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] personal attendant droid, whom he had owned since the [[Clone Wars]]. The droid once had a different body type but his master transferred his logic unit into an [[RQ protocol droid]] at some point prior to the [[Siege of Lothal]]. Willie maintained [[Lando Calrissian's farm|Calrissian's farm]]{{Rebels|Idiot's Array (episode)}} on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Lothal]] when he was not present, performing such tasks as walking Calrissian's [[puffer pig]], which he had [[Mission to Lando Calrissian's farm|acquired]] to begin an illegal [[mining]] operation on the planet. During the Siege of Lothal Willie, under the instructions of Calrissian, helped the [[Spectres]] to escape the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] blockade around Lothal. In return for giving him three of their stolen [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]], the rebels traveled to Calrissian's farm in a stolen Imperial [[shuttle]] to rendezvous with W1-LE, who would assist them. With the aid of the [[Mandalorian]] rebel [[Sabine Wren]], W1-LE created sensor buoys that would replicate the signal of the shuttle and scatter Imperial forces when they tried to track them. This plan worked and the rebels escaped the Imperial blockade and rejoined [[Phoenix Cell]]'s fleet in deep space. Unknown to both Willie and the rebels, the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] had planted a [[Homing beacon|tracking device]] aboard the shuttle and used it to [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (4 BBY)|assault]] Phoenix Squadron's fleet. ==Personality and traits== W1-LE had a laid-back personality but was still able to manage his master Lando Calrissian's farm and mining operation on Lothal. He was also skilled and resourceful enough to help the Spectres develop sensor buoys that allowed them to escape the Imperial blockade above Lothal. ==Behind the scenes== W1-LE was first mentioned in ''[[Rebel Bluff]]'', a short story by [[Michael Kogge]] that was published in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 158|158]]. ==Appearances== *{{InsiderCite|158|Rebel Bluff|reprint=1}} {{1stm}} *{{SWRMCite|21|Puffer Problems}} {{Hologram}} *''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]'' {{1st}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' {{DLC}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: Outer Rim|''Star Wars'': Outer Rim]] *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Protocol and Service Droids}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|willie-w1-le|Willie (W1-LE)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=W1-LE |fr=W1-LE |ja=W1-LE |ka=W1-LE |nl=W1-LE |pl=W1-LE }} [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:RQ protocol droids]]
